title: Settings
saveError: Could not save settings. Try again or restart the app.

language.label: Language
language.caption: Sets the language for menus, buttons and labels throughout the app. AI answers stay in whatever language you type.

license.freeBlurb: Import, browse and build sets manually. Unlock suggestions, Set Architect, Recall and export with Pro.

status.deviceMismatch: This licence is activated on another device. Deactivate it there, or contact support to move it — your key is otherwise valid.
status.revoked: This licence was cancelled or refunded. If that’s unexpected, contact support and we’ll help.
status.expired: Your subscription has lapsed. Renew to restore Pro — your settings and library are untouched.
status.invalid: This stored key couldn’t be verified. Re-paste it, or contact support.
status.clockWarning: Your system clock looks like it moved backwards. Pro still works; just check your date & time so subscription dates stay accurate.

license.refreshDone: License status is up to date.

activationError.malformed: That key doesn't look right. Check for typos and try again.
activationError.badSignature: This key couldn't be verified. Re-copy it from your receipt, or contact support.
activationError.expired: This license has expired. Renew to restore Pro.
activationError.deviceMismatch: This key is active on another device. Deactivate it there first, or contact support.
activationError.revoked: This license was cancelled or refunded. Contact support if that’s unexpected.
activationError.unknown: Could not activate that key. Check your connection and try again.

learnMode.label: Learn Mode
learnMode.caption: Adds in-line explanations + diagrams to every recommendation. Great for picking up harmonic mixing, BPM transitions, and energy arcs.

plainSearch.label: Plain-English search
plainSearch.caption: Understands looser, messier phrasing on top of the built-in search — so “something chilled around 120” just works. Runs entirely on your Mac, offline and private. Turn off to keep it out of memory.

keyNotation.label: Key notation
keyNotation.caption: Controls how keys are shown on track rows and key chips throughout the app.

targetHardware.label: Default target hardware
targetHardware.detail: Sets the Pioneer CDJ model used during export validation — controls allowed file formats, max bitrate, hot-cue count, and folder layout. Pick the model your booth uses.

bpmRange.label: Default BPM range
bpmRange.detail: The tempo window Set Architect and Suggestions stay within. Narrower = more cohesive flow; wider = more candidate tracks. 8–10 BPM is a typical club range.

harmonicMixing.label: Harmonic mixing
harmonicMixing.detail: When on, Set Architect prefers adjacent or same-letter Camelot keys, keeping the harmonic colour consistent and avoiding key clashes. Turn off if you intentionally want jarring key shifts.
harmonicMixing.caption: On by default in Set Architect

autoDetect.label: Auto-detect Rekordbox
autoDetect.caption: On launch, look for Rekordbox on this Mac so import is one click.

crashReporting.label: Crash reporting
crashReporting.caption: Opt in to send anonymous crash reports when the app unexpectedly quits. Reports include only the error type, a redacted stack trace (filenames, no paths), your OS version, and the app version.
crashReporting.privacyNote: Your library, track titles, file paths, your device name, and personal data are never included. Off by default. Turning it off stops reporting immediately; turning it on takes effect after restarting {{app}}.

sentry.label: Error tracking
sentry.caption: Opt in to send anonymized error and performance data when {{app}} encounters problems. This helps us fix bugs faster and keep things stable.
sentry.privacyNote: Reports are redacted: no library contents, track titles, file paths, or personal data. Off by default. Changes take effect immediately.

flightRecorder.label: Set Flight Recorder
flightRecorder.caption: Record a lo-fi audio reference of your set from the room mic while you're live, so you can play it back later. The tracklist is always saved — this adds the audio.
flightRecorder.privacyNote: Off by default. The recording stays on this device and is never uploaded. You choose to keep or discard each set when it ends, and a recording indicator shows whenever the mic is capturing.
flightRecorder.reactionCaption: After a set, measure how the crowd reacted to each track from the recording. Early and approximate — shown as estimates with a confidence until it's proven in real rooms.

backup.exportCaption: Saves your tags, sets, play history, lifecycle and smart crates to a single <0>.setrecord</0> file. Keep it safe, or import it on another Mac to move your work across. Your audio files and license stay put — nothing is uploaded.
backup.encryptedNote: Encrypted with your passphrase — you’ll need it to import. There’s no recovery if it’s lost.
backup.unencryptedNote: Backups are encrypted by default. Leave this blank and we’ll ask you to confirm before saving an unencrypted file anyone could read.
backup.importCaption: Import a <0>.setrecord</0> file from another Mac. Import your Rekordbox/Serato library first — a backup carries your work, not the audio, and re-links to the tracks already on this machine.
backup.restoreHint: This library is empty — import your Rekordbox/Serato library first, then re-run for best results.
backup.mergeHint: Will merge onto your current library — your local cues, ratings and tags are never overwritten.
backup.importSuccess: Backup imported — your library has been updated.
backup.notFoundHint: . Import the missing audio and re-run to link them.
backup.partialSets_one: {{count}} set imported with some tracks missing.
backup.partialSets_other: {{count}} sets imported with some tracks missing.

dangerZone.label: Reset {{app}}
dangerZone.caption: Erase your library, settings and play history and return {{app}} to how it looked the very first time you opened it. Your music files and your Pro licence stay put.
dangerZone.confirmDetail: Permanently deletes your library, settings and play history, and restarts {{app}} at first launch. Your audio files and Pro licence are untouched.

density.caption: How tightly track rows pack in the library list.

launch.label: Open to
launch.caption: Which workspace SetRecord opens to when you launch it.

reducedMotion.label: Reduce motion
reducedMotion.caption: Freeze the animated background and minimise transitions. Your system setting is always respected too.

beginnerMode.label: Beginner mode
beginnerMode.caption: Keep the plain-language explanations of DJ jargon, even after any trial ends.

voiceInput.label: Voice input
voiceInput.caption: Hold to talk to the Home box — transcribed privately on your Mac. Turn off to hide the mic button.

exportFormat.label: Default export format
exportFormat.caption: Which export the Export window pre-selects.

playback.lengthCaption: How long a preview plays before it stops on its own.
playback.fadeCaption: Ease previews in with a short fade instead of a hard start.
playback.outputCaption: Where preview audio plays. Defaults to your system output.
playback.inputCaption: The audio input SetRecord Live listens to.
playback.waveformCaption: Higher detail draws sharper waveforms but decodes a little slower.

autoTagging.label: Auto-tagging
autoTagging.caption: Let SetRecord generate plain-language tags from each track's sound.

tagRoute.label: Rekordbox tag export
tagRoute.caption: XML only keeps tags out of the live Rekordbox database — the safe default. Allow DB write also offers the direct MyTag option.

rbConsent.label: Rekordbox database access
rbConsent.caption: You've allowed SetRecord to read your Rekordbox database (read-only). Revoke it here; you'll be asked again next time.

updates.label: Check for updates
updates.caption: Look for new releases and let you know — never installs automatically.
updates.preReleaseCaption: Also offer beta builds when checking.
updates.resultUnavailable: Updates aren't available in this build.

offline.label: Offline mode
offline.caption: Block all network access — update checks and any model downloads.

artworkCache.label: Album artwork cache
artworkCache.caption: Cached cover art currently uses {{size}}. Clearing it frees space; art re-extracts as you browse.

replayOnboarding.label: Replay the welcome tour
replayOnboarding.caption: Show the first-run onboarding again from the start.
